posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
Looks like photos can only be viewed by someone logged in. I couldn't see a simple way to make photos viewable by anonymous viewers.

I've got a standing offer for spots in my gallery for anyone that needs space for their pictures... [http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/v/PCG/](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/v/PCG/)

Of course, you'd still have another login to keep track of.

posts.author: ErichRose
posts.content_md: Thanks Michael, I would like to take advantage of your offer if that's what it takes to get some images onto the forum. What do I need to do to do so? If you want, send the instructions directly to my e-mail address. I wil not have time to get to it until this evening anyway.

I can't wait to see your new stuff.
